methodology: The 2022-02-23 baseline uses the static prewar Crimea/Donbas footprint. Each actual archived DeepState date uses the union of that footprint and its Russian-occupied Polygon/MultiPolygon geometry, including nested GeometryCollections. Transnistria is excluded and its footprint subtracted before intersecting the union with each OCHA/geoBoundaries ADM1 polygon. Turf calculates geodesic overlap areas, capped to each region area for numeric precision; overlapping polygons count only once. All 27 regions use the same static administrative geometry. National summaries retain the independent NZZ observation at or before the map date and its reported_national_date; all reported national values are null if no prior observation exists. Only archive dates and the explicit baseline are published, without interpolation.
limitation: Regional values are map-derived geometric estimates, not surveyed cadastral areas. Archive gaps are real and do not locate the exact day of a control change. The prewar footprint is retained in every frame. Regional values can differ from the independently modeled national occupied-area series because boundaries, dates, and methodology differ; the NZZ observation date may precede the map date.
